0162567a44.q: What are the three key shifts health plans must make based on the 2027 Star Ratings environment?
0162567a44.a: First, star strategies must move from score management to performance system management. Second, the center of gravity is moving closer to clinical execution and outcomes, requiring stronger connections between payer strategy and actual member-provider interactions. Third, Stars must be treated as an enterprise risk because the economic consequences of quality performance now extend far beyond the quality department.

98ad8d6f88.q: How does latency in responding to performance changes affect Star Ratings outcomes according to the 2027 environment?
98ad8d6f88.a: Latency—the time between learning something and acting on it—will become increasingly punitive in the next era of Stars. Two organizations identifying the same problem may respond differently: one in two weeks versus another spending two months validating and socializing the insight. This difference in execution speed, not just performance insight, will become one of the most important competitive differences between plans.
